name: casual
title: Casual SFX Pack
description: Sound effects for hyper-casual and casual mobile web games. Designed to pair with the Super Casual UI Kit.
style: Modern mobile casual game audio: clean, bright, punchy, lightly processed. Not retro/8-bit, not cinematic/orchestral. Mono, dry (no long reverb tails), normalized to -1 dBFS peak.

sourceMeaning.code: Synthesized by the runtime, permanently. No audio file, no download, infinite variation. These sounds are synthetic by nature so code beats a recording.
sourceMeaning.ai: Generated as an audio file (ElevenLabs Sound Effects or similar) from the prompt below. These sounds carry real-world material texture that code cannot fake.
sourceMeaning.hybrid: A coded layer plus a generated layer. The code part ships immediately; the audio part deepens it later.

ui.tap.whenToUse: The player taps any button. The most-used sound in the game.

ui.tap.soft.whenToUse: Secondary taps: list rows, tab switches, small toggles. Quieter than ui.tap.

ui.back.whenToUse: Back, close or cancel. The darker twin of ui.tap.

ui.confirm.whenToUse: A choice is accepted: settings saved, difficulty picked, name entered.

ui.error.whenToUse: The action is not allowed: not enough coins, locked level, wrong move.

ui.toggle.whenToUse: A switch, checkbox or tab changes state.

ui.tick.whenToUse: Countdown timer in its warning seconds, or a number counting up.

ui.whoosh.whenToUse: A popup opens or a screen slides in.

ui.swipe.whenToUse: The player swipes a card, page or carousel.

ui.notify.whenToUse: Something new appeared: a message, a gift, a quest, a friend request.

ui.unlock.whenToUse: A level, skin, chapter or feature unlocks.

ui.locked.whenToUse: The player taps something still locked.

ui.countdown.whenToUse: 3… 2… 1… before a level starts. Play once per number, then state.go.

ui.go.whenToUse: The GO! at the end of a countdown, when gameplay starts.

ui.slider.whenToUse: A slider handle passes a step. Fires rapidly, so it is very short and quiet.

object.chain.prompt: Loud heavy metal chain being dragged and rattling, dry close recording

object.rope.whenToUse: Rope creaks under tension — pulling, climbing, bridge.
object.rope.prompt: Loud thick rope creaking under heavy tension, fibrous strain, dry close recording

object.glass.clink.prompt: Loud two glass bottles clinking together once, clear ringing glass, dry close recording

object.coin.drop.whenToUse: A coin falls onto a hard surface.
object.coin.drop.prompt: Loud metal coin dropping onto a hard stone floor and spinning to rest, dry close recording

object.switch.whenToUse: A physical switch or lever is thrown.
object.switch.prompt: Loud heavy industrial lever switch being thrown, solid mechanical clunk, dry close recording

object.balloon.pop.whenToUse: A balloon bursts — party, target, bubble.
object.balloon.pop.prompt: Loud balloon popping close to the microphone, sharp rubber burst, dry recording

sequence.prompt: Several party balloons being burst one after another right next to the microphone, loud explosive rubber pops, dry indoor recording

object.firework.whenToUse: A firework launches and bursts — celebration.
object.firework.prompt: Loud firework whistling upward then bursting with a bright crackling explosion, outdoor recording

vehicle.horn.prompt: Loud car horn honking once, dry outdoor recording

vehicle.rev.whenToUse: An engine revs hard — boost, start line, showing off.
vehicle.rev.prompt: Loud car engine revving hard, throttle blipped with a rising roar, recorded close

vehicle.gear.prompt: Loud mechanical gear lever shifting into place, solid metallic clunk, dry close recording

vehicle.helicopter.prompt: Loud helicopter rotor blades beating overhead, continuous steady chopping, recorded close

vehicle.plane.prompt: Loud jet aircraft flying past overhead, rising then falling roar, outdoor recording

vehicle.train.whenToUse: A train passes or pulls away.
vehicle.train.prompt: Loud train rolling along rails past the microphone, rhythmic wheel clatter, outdoor recording

vehicle.boat.whenToUse: A small boat motor runs. Loops.
vehicle.boat.prompt: Loud small outboard boat motor running steadily on water, continuous engine drone, recorded close

vehicle.bike.prompt: Loud bicycle bell ringing twice, bright metallic ping, dry outdoor recording

machine.robot.servo.whenToUse: A robot joint moves — mech, turret, droid.
machine.robot.servo.prompt: Loud robotic servo motor moving a mechanical joint, whirring electric motor with a soft clunk, dry recording

machine.steam.whenToUse: Steam vents — machinery, valve, pressure release.
machine.steam.prompt: Loud burst of pressurised steam venting from a metal valve, sharp hissing release, dry recording

machine.conveyor.whenToUse: A conveyor or factory line runs. Loops.
machine.conveyor.prompt: Loud factory conveyor belt running with rollers turning, continuous mechanical rumble, dry recording

machine.elevator.whenToUse: A lift arrives and the doors open.
machine.elevator.prompt: Loud elevator arriving with a bell ding then metal doors sliding open, dry indoor recording

scifi.scanner.whenToUse: A scanner sweeps — detection, radar, search.
scifi.scanner.prompt: Science fiction scanner sweeping, loud electronic warbling sweep with a digital ping, clean synthetic recording

scifi.airlock.whenToUse: A pressurised door opens — spaceship, vault, lab.
scifi.airlock.prompt: Loud heavy science fiction airlock door unsealing with a pressure hiss and deep mechanical thud

scifi.powerdown.whenToUse: A machine or system powers down.
scifi.powerdown.prompt: Loud science fiction machine powering down, falling electronic whine dropping in pitch to silence

scifi.powerup.whenToUse: A machine or system powers up.
scifi.powerup.prompt: Loud science fiction machine powering up, rising electronic hum building to a steady tone

scifi.glitch.whenToUse: A digital error or corruption — hacking, damage, static.
scifi.glitch.prompt: Loud digital glitch burst, stuttering electronic static and corrupted data noise, synthetic recording

scifi.hologram.prompt: Science fiction hologram switching on, loud electronic shimmer with a flickering projector hum

rpg.potion.whenToUse: A potion is drunk — healing, buff.
rpg.potion.prompt: Loud liquid being gulped from a glass bottle then a cork stopper popping, dry close recording

rpg.scroll.prompt: Loud old parchment scroll being unrolled, dry crackling paper, close recording

rpg.armor.equip.whenToUse: Armour or heavy gear is put on.
rpg.armor.equip.prompt: Loud metal armour plates being fitted together, heavy clanking steel, dry close recording

rpg.sword.draw.whenToUse: A blade is drawn from a sheath.
rpg.sword.draw.prompt: Loud steel sword being drawn quickly from a leather sheath, metallic ringing scrape, dry recording

rpg.spell.cast.prompt: Loud magic spell being cast, swirling energy rush with a bright magical shimmer and a deep whoosh

rpg.curse.whenToUse: A dark spell or debuff lands.
rpg.curse.prompt: Loud dark magic curse landing, low ominous swell with a twisted metallic shriek, sinister

rpg.enchant.whenToUse: An item is enchanted or blessed.
rpg.enchant.prompt: Loud magical enchantment being placed on an object, rising crystalline shimmer with a warm glowing hum

rpg.quest.accept.whenToUse: A quest is accepted or a journal updates.
rpg.quest.accept.prompt: Loud fantasy game quest accepted sound, warm rising harp flourish with a soft parchment rustle

rpg.gold.whenToUse: A pile of gold coins is gathered.
rpg.gold.prompt: Loud handful of gold coins being scooped up and jingling together, dry close recording

rpg.trap.whenToUse: A trap springs — spikes, snare, alarm.
rpg.trap.prompt: Loud metal spike trap springing shut, fast mechanical snap with ringing steel, dry recording

game.spawn.whenToUse: An enemy or object appears in the world.
game.spawn.prompt: Loud magical spawn sound, quick rising whoosh with a bright energetic pop as something appears

game.checkpoint.whenToUse: A checkpoint is reached — progress saved.
game.checkpoint.prompt: Loud game checkpoint reached sound, warm rising three note chime with a soft magical sparkle

game.wave.start.whenToUse: A new wave or round begins — tower defence, survival.
game.wave.start.prompt: Loud battle horn signalling the start of an enemy wave, deep brass call with a war drum hit

game.tower.place.whenToUse: A tower, building or block is placed.
game.tower.place.prompt: Loud wooden and stone structure being set down firmly into place, solid thud with a settling clatter

game.shield.break.prompt: Loud energy shield shattering, bright crystalline crack with an electric fizzing collapse

game.bullet.whizby.whenToUse: A projectile flies close past the player.
game.bullet.whizby.prompt: Loud bullet whizzing fast past the microphone, sharp air zip with a doppler pitch drop, dry recording

game.ricochet.whenToUse: A bullet or projectile bounces off metal or stone.
game.ricochet.prompt: Loud bullet ricocheting off metal, sharp metallic ping with a whining departure, dry recording

game.portal.whenToUse: A portal opens or is entered.
game.portal.prompt: Loud magical portal opening, deep swirling vortex with rising energy and an otherworldly hum
